terms: The estimate will be valid for a period of 30 days. The quotation is inclusive of GST and transportation.
The actual cost of the project will depend on the final sign-off drawings.
60% advance payment at the time of booking. Second payment of 30% after delivery. Balance 10% payment upon completion of installation. Any payment made is strictly non-refundable.
Casemelia will not process any file without the client's signature on the agreed proposal and drawings. Mail confirmation will not be accepted unless the signature is endorsed and mailed.

Delivery will be within 4–5 weeks from the finalization of designs, shades, hardware, accessories, and sign-off on production drawings by the client. Casemelia will not be responsible for delays caused by unforeseen circumstances or delays in finalization of drawings/designs.

Accessories/electrical items shown in the images are not part of the product unless mentioned separately. The quotation clearly specifies the inclusions, and anything beyond the stated inclusions will be chargeable.

Casemelia reserves the right to alter/change materials based on technical requirements or material availability without compromising the aesthetics and life of the product. There may be a variation between the color displayed on the website and the actual product color. Slight variations may also occur between the aluminum profile/edge banding and the shutter. Confirmation will be taken from the client.
All modular components manufactured at the factory carry a lifetime warranty, and non-modular components carry a 10-year warranty, subject to site wear and tear conditions.

Civil, plumbing, electrical wiring, and floor protection will be the client's scope. Casemelia will only provide the marking for the same, if required. Power supply should be provided by the client/builder.
No changes will be entertained under any circumstances after sign-off on the production drawings. No alterations will be accepted once delivery is made.

Casemelia will not be responsible for any electrical, plumbing, or civil changes carried out on site after sign-off. All civil and electrical changes must be made after informing the designer, as per requirements, before sign-off and should be reflected in the production drawings.
The client will be responsible for ensuring ample access to move the material into the property and for providing safe and secure storage.
The designs/furniture models shared with the client are the property of Casemelia. Sharing them with competitors will constitute a violation of copyrights.
